Role.title: Role
Role.description: Represents a user role within the StyleTrack application. This is now managed via Custom Claims.

role.description: The role assigned to the user as a custom claim.

Paca.title: Paca
Paca.description: Represents a bale of clothes in the inventory.

idPersonalizado.description: Custom sequential ID for the bale (e.g., P1, P2).

etiqueta.description: Tag or label for the bale.

cantidadPrendas.description: Number of garments in the bale.

fecha.description: The date the bale was received.

ventaTotalPotencial.description: The potential total sale amount for all garments in the bale.

colorEtiqueta.description: The hex color code for the bale's labels.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the document was created.

inventarioCompleto.description: Flag to indicate if the initial inventory for this bale has been fully registered.

prendaNextId.description: The next sequential ID to use for a new garment group in this bale.

observaciones.description: Optional notes or observations about the bale.

Prenda.title: Prenda
Prenda.description: Represents a single garment or a group of identical garments within a paca.

idPersonalizado.description: Custom sequential ID for the garment group (e.g., P1-1, P1-2).

talla.description: Size of the garment (e.g., 'S', 'M', 'L', 'Única'). Can be disabled by admin.

precioVenta.description: The effective unit selling price, calculated from an offer if one exists.

precioIndividual.description: The price for a single item if sold outside of an offer. Required if an offer is set.

ofertaCantidad.description: The number of items in a bulk offer (e.g., 2 in a '2 for $100' deal).

ofertaPrecio.description: The total price for a bulk offer (e.g., 100 in a '2 for $100' deal).

cantidad.description: Number of identical items in this group. Defaults to 1.

pacaId.description: The ID of the paca this garment belongs to.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the document was created.

totalVenta.description: The total amount of the sale.

metodoPago.description: Payment method used for the sale.

fecha.description: The date and time of the sale.

comprobanteUrl.description: URL to the uploaded payment proof image in Firebase Storage.

VentaItem.title: VentaItem
VentaItem.description: Represents a single item within a sale, linking to a Prenda.

prendaId.description: The ID of the Prenda document.

pacaId.description: The ID of the Paca the Prenda belongs to.

idPersonalizado.description: The custom ID of the garment sold.

cantidad.description: The quantity of this item sold in the transaction.

precioVenta.description: The selling price of the item at the time of sale.

tipoPrenda.description: The type of the garment sold.

fecha.description: The date and time of the expense.

metodoPago.description: The payment method used for the expense.

isTallaEnabled.description: If true, the 'talla' (size) field is enabled for garments. Defaults to true.

Cliente.title: Cliente
Cliente.description: Represents a customer of the store.

notas.description: Notes about what the client is looking for (e.g., specific garments, sizes).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the client was added.

Apartado.title: Apartado
Apartado.description: Represents a layaway plan for a client.

vendedorId.description: ID of the user who created the layaway.

totalPagado.description: The sum of all payments made.

archivado.description: Flag to indicate if the layaway is archived and hidden from the main view.

fechaLiquidacion.description: Timestamp when the layaway was fully paid.

ApartadoItem.title: ApartadoItem
ApartadoItem.description: Represents an item within a layaway plan.

Pago.title: Pago
Pago.description: Represents a single payment (abono) for a layaway plan.

/roles_admin/{userId}.description: Manages user roles. This collection is used by the app to grant 'admin' or 'empleado' permissions as a fallback to Custom Claims.

/pacas/{pacaId}.description: Collection to store all the bales of clothes.

/pacas/{pacaId}/prendas/{prendaId}.description: Subcollection to store individual garments for a specific paca.

/ventas/{ventaId}.description: Collection to store all sales transactions.

/ventas/{ventaId}/items/{itemId}.description: Subcollection to store the individual items sold in a transaction.

/gastos/{gastoId}.description: Collection to store all business expenses.

/app_config/settings.description: Stores global application settings, like feature flags.

/apartados/{apartadoId}.description: Collection to store all layaway plans.

/apartados/{apartadoId}/items/{itemId}.description: Subcollection to store the individual items in a layaway plan.

/apartados/{apartadoId}/pagos/{pagoId}.description: Subcollection to store individual payments for a specific layaway.
